main.description: Lists contribution records by publisher DID, sorted by createdAt and URI; authentication is not required.

authors.description: Repeated unbracketed publisher DIDs are ORed; use at most 100 values.

sortDirection.description: Sort direction for createdAt and URI; defaults to desc.

limit.description: Maximum records in a page from 1 to 100; defaults to 25.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to sortDirection; keep filters unchanged between pages.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An author DID, sort direction, page bound, or cursor is invalid.

errors.name: ContributionQueryFailed
errors.description: The contribution records or publishers could not be read from PostgreSQL.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; omitted after the last page.
